name: The Chariot
general: Determination and decisive progress toward a clear goal.
love: Intense passion; needs to keep its own direction within the relationship.
career: Willpower to overcome obstacles and lead progress.
shadow: Impulsiveness or inner tension between forces pulling in opposite directions.
gift: Discipline to direct the will toward a concrete goal.

positions.puntoE: When Arcana 7 occupies your Point E, your comfort zone lies in moving forward, not in standing still: you feel most like yourself when you have a clear goal to direct your energy toward, and the sense of progress — even small progress — gives you emotional stability. Staying still for too long without direction can genuinely unsettle you. The risk is that this need for progress becomes impulsiveness: charging ahead without properly assessing the terrain, or generating inner tension between forces pulling in opposite directions within yourself. Learning to direct your determination with more discernment, without losing the drive that defines you, is your task from this point.
positions.colaKarmica: When Arcana 7 appears in your karmic tail, it suggests that in inherited patterns you advanced by force, imposing your will without listening enough to those around you, or that you fought battles that weren't really yours. This life invites you to heal that pattern: to learn that true victory isn't found in winning at any cost, but in directing your will with awareness of who your progress might affect. It's common to feel the urge to win even in situations where cooperating would bring better results, and learning to let go of that need for control is part of this life's work.
positions.lineaDinero: If Arcana 7 sits in your money line, your relationship with prosperity tends to be marked by drive and determination: you generate better results when you pursue a concrete financial goal with discipline, and you tend to stagnate in passive contexts or without clear direction. The typical block is jumping into opportunities without enough planning, letting yourself be carried by the urge to move fast rather than by strategy. Learning to combine your willpower with more patience and prior analysis tends to translate into a more solid, less erratic prosperity.
positions.lineaMasculina: In your masculine or paternal line, Arcana 7 brings an energy of determination and decisive progress: it can reflect a fighting, goal-oriented paternal figure who taught, through example, the importance of not giving up. If that inheritance was lived out of balance, you may have experienced tension, excessive competitiveness, or difficulty showing vulnerability in that figure. Your task is to integrate the inherited willpower without feeling that you always have to be in fighting or advancing mode to have worth.
positions.lineaFemenina: In your feminine or maternal line, Arcana 7 expresses itself as an energy of decisive progress and strength of character: it can reflect a maternal figure who faced difficulties with remarkable determination, forging her own path even in adverse circumstances. In its less balanced form, this may have felt like constant tension or difficulty letting her guard down within the home. Recognising this pattern lets you value the inherited strength without feeling that you always have to be fighting for something in order to feel whole.
